milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the light blue wall banner (placed at spawn-relative [3, 3, 5] on the west wall of the stone brick structure) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the banner rather than facing away.
